column1: # tool_use_id -> agent_id recovery for the fanout leg of the loop-detector corpus gate.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The five calls it names were made by five different
# subagents, and the ledger records every one of them as agent_id "main": they
# predate 4c1cd0a ("read agent_id from the payload, so fan-out detection can
# fire", 2026-09-30), so the hook that wrote them had no way to tell a subagent
# call from a main-thread one. The real leg is committed exactly as the field
# wrote it, collapse included, so the attribution is carried BESIDE it rather
# than patched into it.
# The repaired leg is GENERATED from these two inputs on every run and is never
# committed. A committed second copy would assert that the derivation was once
# performed; a derivation the gate performs each run is the derivation under
# test.
# THE RECOVERY RULE -- the one scripts/loop-metrics.sh --for already uses: a
# tool_use_id ABSENT from the session's main transcript and present in exactly
# one subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl was made by agent <id>. It is recorded here as
# a SHAPE and never as a literal path, because this directory is exactly where
# the no-home-directory check greps, and a real path in the file that documents
# the scrub would be that needle, planted by its own documentation:
#   grep -l <tool_use_id> "$CLAUDE_PROJECTS/<session-id>/subagents/agent-"*.jsonl
# Re-derived 2026-10-05 against the live tree, BOTH halves checked: exactly one
# subagent hit each with no collisions, and all five absent from the main
# transcript. The absence half is not decoration -- "present in one subagent
# file" alone is also true of a main-thread call a subagent merely quoted.
# Only agent_id is rewritten. The stored `transcript` pointer is left alone: the
# detector never reads it, and rewriting it would make the fixture assert
# something about a field this change does not touch.
# The five are the tail of the fingerprint family fp=3562779350 (`Read` of the
# method file every subagent is told to read), at call ordinals 1445, 1446,
# 1458, 1470 and 1471 of the real leg.
